candidateAssessments.sourceEvidence: skill.go:120-155; one direct QueueAttack at 148 on the false HasBlessing branch; true branch exits Nightsoul and returns before queueing. Hit frame 3; plan closes only when pending-aim-release fact is 0.
candidateAssessments.audit: Skill calls HasBlessing once at entry; false queues one hit then enters Nightsoul, true exits and queues none. particleCB only sets its per-use flag and grants particles (158-167); point-reduction tasks alter Nightsoul state only (109-117). Init installs A1/A4 state/hooks (chasca.go:46-64); A4 independently reacts to OnNightsoulBurst and queues shell damage (asc.go:58-92), and C2/C4 callbacks attach to later Shadowhunt shell attacks (cons.go:40-94), not E. If recast occurs in AimState, exitNightsoul schedules fireBullets for previously charged aimed shots (skill.go:83-107; aimed.go:190-244); when exitNightsoul selects AimState, the helper schedules fireBullets for previously charged aimed shots (skill.go:88-93; aimed.go:190-244); without an owner binding to that prior aimed action the E plan is partial on this branch. The plan is enabled only when native fact `chasca.skill.pending-aim-release` is 0. PRE124 Stellar skill differs in animation-frame table and tag type; branch/root behavior is same.

candidateAssessments.sourceEvidence: burst.go:28-71 Classic queues Cryo damage at frame 82 and a zero-damage talisman-application attack at frame 40. Stellar queues the same two; under `revelation && getRadiance()==radianceStellarConduct` it additionally queues a direct Stellar Conduct attack at frame 82.
candidateAssessments.audit: The cast always queues two deliveries: one Cryo damage root at 82 and one zero-damage AttackTagNone/Physical talisman-application root at 40. The talisman callback applies a 15s enemy status only if that zero-damage attack hits an enemy (Classic burst.go:53-60; Stellar burst.go:27-43). Stellar has an additional direct Q attack only in the original revelation/Stellar Conduct condition and calls c6OnBurst, which changes status/energy/heal behavior; source lane diff is semantically material and represented by branch fact `qiqi.burst.stellar-conduct-at-entry`. Init subscriptions heal on later enemy damage and process later Qiqi NA/CA hooks; they do not create another Q attack (qiqi.go:40-48; Classic burst.go:73-120; Stellar burst.go:77 onward). A1/C1/C2 are heal, energy, or later NA/CA modifier hooks (asc.go:15-45; cons.go:13-53); Stellar C4 adds healing when talisman healing occurs; C6-on-Burst sets status/stacks whose additive hook applies to later Normal/Extra hits (cons.go:238-252), not a new Q root. Never claim talisman was applied unless the zero-damage callback actually dispatched to an enemy. Complete E-scope caveat: omitted because E grants persistent global Crowfeather Cover that can later drive a Tengu Juurai: Ambush from fully charged Aimed Shot; this delayed status-to-aimed trigger is outside the direct cast method (skill.go:39-57; aimed.go:66-141).
